answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-distinct-resource staking: each agent must lock a scarce, non-duplicable resource (here, a copper-denominated bond held in escrow) before its vote counts, and every new identity must arrive at a harbor that pays out only after a slow, randomized pulse of peer attestations. Rooting 10,000 sybils costs 10,000 separate bonds plus 10,000 attestation waits, so the attacker's outlay scales linearly while verdict weight stays flat per stake.
